Body.Content:
The Azure App Service team is introducing App Service Certificates. Azure App Service customers can now purchase, configure, and manage SSL certificates right from the Azure portal. The process is intuitive and simplified to a few clicks. For more information, check out:
  • Step-by-step guide
  • Easy-start blog post
